name: Expression Naturalness
description: Analyzes facial expression dynamics for naturalness
algorithm: Expression Naturalness — 픽셀 수준 공간 분석
mechanism:
This method analyzes facial expression dynamics for deepfake detection:

1. **ActionUnit감지**: Facial Action Coding System (FACS) action units (AUs) are detected per frame — AU1 (inner brow raise), AU2 (outer brow raise), AU4 (brow lowerer), AU6 (cheek raiser), AU12 (lip corner puller), etc. The activation intensity of each AU is continuously measured.

2. **ExpressionDynamics분석**: Natural facial expressions follow specific temporal dynamics: onset (muscles contracting, ~0.5s), apex (peak expression, variable duration), and offset (muscle relaxation, typically slower than onset). The method verifies that detected expression transitions follow these physiologically constrained dynamics. Deepfakes may produce expressions that appear/disappear too quickly or show unnatural dynamics.

3. **AUCo-Occurrence검증**: Certain AU combinations are anatomically linked: genuine smiles (Duchenne smiles) involve AU6+AU12 simultaneously, genuine surprise involves AU1+AU2+AU5+AU26. The method checks whether detected AU combinations follow anatomically valid co-occurrence patterns. AI-generated expressions may produce anatomically impossible AU combinations.

4. **Micro-Expression감지**: Brief involuntary micro-expressions (lasting 40-200ms) reveal suppressed emotions. Their presence and naturalness are analyzed — authentic video may contain micro-expressions consistent with the behavioral context, while deepfakes typically lack these subtle physiological signals.

5. **Expression-Context일관성**: Facial expressions should be contextually appropriate — matching speech content, conversational dynamics, and emotional context. The method evaluates expression-speech correlation and emotional trajectory coherence. Deepfakes may produce expressions that are contextually inappropriate or emotionally flat.
parameters:
분석 유형: 픽셀
미디어: 비디오
입력: Video frames extracted at key intervals
출력: 신뢰도 점수 (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: 중간~높음 — 70-88% 단독 정확도. Most effective when combined with other 비디오 forensic methods. Performance depends on 비디오 quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detection of deepfake and AI-generated 비디오 through expression naturalness analysis. This method examines temporal and spatial features that are difficult for AI systems to perfectly replicate, providing evidence for 비디오 authenticity assessment.
strengths:
• Captures temporal artifacts that single-frame analysis misses
• Works with standard 비디오 formats
• Effective against common deepfake techniques
• Can be combined with other 비디오 forensic methods
• Based on established computer vision research
limitations:
• Performance affected by 비디오 compression and resolution
• Some methods require sufficient frame count for temporal analysis
• Effectiveness varies with deepfake generation technique
• Best used as part of a comprehensive multi-method pipeline
• May produce false positives on heavily edited authentic 비디오
